headline: Tragedy in Bashundhara: Model Ridhika Ridhi found dead
summary: The actress and model was discovered deceased in her residence; reports suggest a dispute with her partner prior to the death.
details: Model and actress Ridhika Ridhi was found dead in the Bashundhara residential area of Dhaka.
According to reports, she had a heated argument with her boyfriend over a video call shortly before she was found deceased.
The incident has shocked the local community and her colleagues in the entertainment industry.
Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death to determine the cause.
caption:
A shocking discovery in Bashundhara: Model Ridhika Ridhi has been found dead.

Model and actress Ridhika Ridhi was found dead in the Bashundhara residential area of Dhaka.

According to reports, she had a heated argument with her boyfriend over a video call shortly before she was found deceased.

The incident has shocked the local community and her colleagues in the entertainment industry.

Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding her death to determine the cause.

headline_marked: 7.1 million BDT [[found in donation box of Shahjalal Mazar]]
headline: 7.1 million BDT found in donation box of Shahjalal Mazar
summary: Foreign currency, gold, and silver were also recovered from the shrine's donation box during the latest collection.
details: The donation box of the shrine of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) was opened, revealing a total of 7.1 million BDT in cash.
Alongside the cash, the collection included various foreign currencies, as well as gold and silver ornaments.
A large number of people gathered to witness the counting process, which was conducted under supervision.
The funds collected from the donation box are typically used for the maintenance of the shrine and other charitable activities.
caption:
7.1 million BDT, gold, and silver! That's what was found inside the donation box of Shahjalal Mazar.

The donation box of the shrine of Hazrat Shahjalal (R) was opened, revealing a total of 7.1 million BDT in cash.

Alongside the cash, the collection included various foreign currencies, as well as gold and silver ornaments.

A large number of people gathered to witness the counting process, which was conducted under supervision.

The funds collected from the donation box are typically used for the maintenance of the shrine and other charitable activities.

#Bangladesh #Sylhet #ShahjalalMazar #Donations #News

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo
